Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Amit Kapri, learned counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. B. N. Molakhi, learned D.A.G. for the State. 
3. On behalf of the appellant, it is argued that the 
appellant is not well and he is under treatment. 
4. On this, the report was sought. Learned State 
Counsel gives statement that the appellant had been 
suffering from tuberculosis in the year 2008 and one of 
his lungs has permanently damaged. But now he is under 
regular treatment from Susheela Tiwari Government 
Hospital, Haldwani. 
5. List this matter on 21.09.2026 for final hearing.
6. The Court directs the In-charge of the concerned 
jail, where the appellant is confined, to ensure that 
adequate medical facilities are provided to the appellant 
as per medical advice.
7. A copy of this order be forwarded to the In-charge 
of the concerned jail for compliance.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
